scene_sentence_zh: 雲海之上的夢境王座靜靜矗立，極光在天際流轉，腳下是無垠的蒼穹。

license.terms: Original artwork generated for this repository by its maintainers and committed with the project; it may be redistributed under the project's own repository terms. No third-party stock imagery, scraped artwork, or externally licensed asset is included.

production.method: sd-webui txt2img through the repository's internal client (world.art.sd_worker.SDWebUIClient.generate) using the shipped prompt library, then local WebP encoding through world.art.formats.encode
production.description: an ethereal cloud-throne vista, a high throne of pale luminous stone atop a sea of rolling clouds, a vast dreamlike sky of drifting nebulae and soft aurora light, floating islands dissolving into mist, a broad clear platform of pale marble before the throne, a dreamlike pastel violet and gold palette, an unobstructed open foreground

visual_review.native_scale: Reviewed at native 1536x864: a painterly JRPG dream cloud-throne vista — a pale luminous throne rising from a sea of rolling clouds beneath green-violet aurora bands, floating rocky islands dissolving into mist, and a broad open marble platform across the lower foreground — with no interface, watermark or readable lettering, no physical-room background, and no town/forest reuse.
visual_review.desktop_cover_crop: Reviewed under the desktop 1451x790 cover crop (browser method web.tests.browser.test_browser_bundled_scene_assets.BundledSceneAssetsBrowserTest.test_sacred_pack_static_decode): the full-bleed composition holds and the illustration stays distinguishable from its siblings at that viewport.
visual_review.contact_sheet: Reviewed as a three-up contact sheet beside cave_interior and shrine_interior: scene identity, palette and composition are distinct for every sibling.
